## Worst customer service ever, there's no number to call either
So it appears this is an ongoing thing. But I myself am in the same boat as others. Someone hacked my account. I get an alert that I sent 1700$ and I instantly logged in and started chatting with one of the representatives. As I am typing the hacker was also still in my account and was telling them "oops my mistake, it turns out I did make this transaction" I tried to change my password and passkey and as soon as I did I could not log back in. I tried to do the whole video to reset it and no luck. I contacted support and there only response was "Hi Arian,  
  
Thanks for sharing these details. [...] Thanks for sharing these details.  
  
Our team is conducting an investigation of your Mercury account activity. I have added all of the details you've shared here to the investigation. For security reasons, your account will remain locked until the investigation is complete.  
  
Please leave this with me for now, and I'll get back in touch as soon as possible."  
  
This was 3 WEEKS AGO! Stil haven't heard anything. I don't even care that they closed the account at this point I just want to know when im getting my money back or something. Super frustrating and annoying. I would not recommend banking with them [...] October 17, 2026
